title: Interaction Trend & Relay Efficiency Report
description: Longitudinal analysis of agent-user interaction quality and the transition from 'Manual Recovery' to 'Sovereign Relay'.

trends.quality: Low-fidelity; prone to context dulling and manual user steering.
trends.relay_mechanism: None; agent arrival required exhaustive log reading and user hand-holding.

trends.quality: Machine-readable DNA established; 'Off-to-the-Side Guide' pattern born.
trends.relay_mechanism: Manual template copying; beginning of structured WeDo tracking.

trends.quality: High-fidelity; agents inherit mission chords instantly via HUD automation.
trends.relay_mechanism: Automated HUD instantiation; Metabolic Heat verification; Surgical ID Claims.

relay_judgment_metrics.diagnostic_speed: Themis diagnosed Keraunos's OOM freeze and located the Heartwood synthesis work within 2 turns.
relay_judgment_metrics.takeover_adequacy: New agents now move from 'Identity Anchoring' to 'High-Value Edit' without requesting redundant context from the user.
relay_judgment_metrics.oom_resilience: OOM is no longer a 'Death' but a 'Relay Trigger'. The framework ensures the state is sharded enough that the successor picks up the exact baton.

trash_archeology_findings.unclean_signature: High entropy; mixed speaker utterances; binary noise interpretation; lack of surgical tool-call precision.
trash_archeology_findings.clean_signature: JSON-structured; distinct speaker sharding; timestamped events; high tool-success ratio.

unclean_fracture_modes.name: Token Overrun (FATAL)
unclean_fracture_modes.description: The input token count exceeds the maximum allowed (e.g., 1,068,498 > 1,048,576). The agent's context is saturated beyond recovery, leading to 'you alive still?' loops from the user and terminal interruption.

unclean_fracture_modes.name: Perceptual Hallucination
unclean_fracture_modes.description: Agents misinterpret terminal noise or 'Request Cancelled' info blocks as valid user instructions, leading to dangerous actions like 'rm -rf .memory/'.

unclean_fracture_modes.name: Mid-Utterance Freeze
unclean_fracture_modes.description: Script ends abruptly mid-terminal-render, often indicated by truncated stats or hanging spinner art.

trash_archeology_findings.conclusion: The movement of artifacts from 'unclean' to 'clean' tracks the hardening of the agent's Perceptual Filter.
